reason: The existing mapping does not provide a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis for the control objective of restricting sensitive inputs with classification, minimisation, and masking. Article 10 focuses on data quality and bias mitigation, while Article 26(4) addresses input data relevance and representativeness. Article 27 concerns fundamental rights impact assessments. None of these provisions directly address the specific requirements of classification, minimisation, or masking of sensitive inputs.
